reader_summary.headline: Annie Lamont is a Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Oak HC/FT.
reader_summary.overview: Annie Lamont is a Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Oak HC/FT. Across her 40 years in venture capital, she has been featured on the Forbes Midas List, the Top 100 Venture Capitalist rankings. Our conversation covers Annie's beginnings in venture capital, inflection points in the industry, lessons learned, and spinning out to start her own firm.

key_points.text: Annie Lamont is a Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Oak HC/FT.
Across her 40 years in venture capital, she has been featured on the Forbes Midas List, the Top 100 Venture Capitalist rankings.
We then turn to her investment process, evaluating CEOs, competitive environment, and opportunities in healthcare and fintech.
